description: This header file defines the interface for GStreamer protection metadata related to Rialto EME (Encrypted Media Extensions). It includes structure definitions, macro definitions, and function declarations for managing protection metadata within GStreamer buffers.

classes.name: GstRialtoProtectionMetadata
classes.description: Structure representing Rialto protection metadata in GStreamer buffers, containing a parent GstMeta and a GstStructure *info.

methods.name: rialto_eme_protection_metadata_get_type
methods.description: Returns the GType for Rialto EME protection metadata, used for GObject type system.

methods.name: rialto_mse_protection_metadata_get_info
methods.description: Returns a pointer to GstMetaInfo describing the protection metadata.

methods.name: rialto_mse_add_protection_metadata
methods.description: Adds protection metadata to a GstBuffer with the provided GstStructure *info.
